description:
Rocket.Chat is open at the login screen in the browser. Log in with:
- Username: admin
- Password: Admin1234!

Use Rocket.Chat's search functionality to search for the keyword "7.8.5" across messages. The #release-updates channel contains real release announcements from the official Rocket.Chat GitHub releases feed. Find the message that mentions release 7.8.5, then reply to that message in a thread with this exact text:
"Confirmed: 7.8.5 backport patches verified in staging environment."
